title: Enhance Your Windows Experience with PowerToys
summary: This post describes Windows PowerToys, a collection of utilities and tools that enhance Windows functionality, including mouse utilities, image resizer, color picker, and advanced system editors.
key_points: PowerToys is an open-source Microsoft tool suite with quality-of-life utilities for Windows users
Includes mouse utilities, image resizer, color picker, file locksmith, and workspace management
Advanced tools like environment variables editor, host file editor, and registry preview require careful use
Tools can be individually activated or deactivated through a dashboard interface
